protocol.scope: Stage 4 raw candidates -> optional MCTS -> identical fixed BUE -> CBT
protocol.selection: All 140 abnormal test videos across 13 categories. Normal videos excluded before inference.
protocol.pairing: One shared upstream discovery; off completes before any search. Each active policy independently executes the current MCTS refiner with its own budget/tree and video state.
protocol.api_replay: Per-video exact-request cache: only identical model settings, prompts and image bytes share successful replies. This is a live paired run, not frozen-tree replay.
protocol.frozen: All Stage 4 candidates retained, discovery confidences and predicted categories fixed. Stage 5 and intermediate refinements/top-k/NMS/classification/gating/QSCORE bypassed.
protocol.search: shrink, all_valid, 8 simulations, depth 4, 2 candidates/video, 10 logical requests/candidate and 20/video, 32 evidence images, boundary gap 1.5s/evidence gap 3s.
protocol.evaluation: VadCLIP noninterpolated class-aware AP; 13 abnormal classes, native FPS, integer half-open frames, IoU 0.1:0.1:0.5. No normal-video evaluation.
protocol.costs: Result-level aggregate includes historical imported usage; current execution API usage is separately saved in results/metadata/token_usage*.json. Cache-affected branch times are not standalone comparisons.
protocol.limitations: All abnormal test videos but no normal videos, so no normal-video FPR estimate. Prior test-set use means this is not an independent holdout. CBT priors unchanged; historical provenance unverified. GT only used for evaluation.
protocol.reuse: 60 verified prior four-arm abnormal-video results + 80 new live four-arm videos; source files and inference manifests matched. Full mAP reranked/recomputed jointly on all 140.
